subject: general
question: Gitika borrowed a sum of Rs. 20,000 at a certain rate of simple interest for 2 years. If she paid an interest of Rs. 4,000 at the end of the period, then find the rate of interest per annum.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Interest for 1 year** = 4000 ÷ 2 = ₹2000

**Rate of interest** = (Interest for 1 year ÷ Principal) × 100

Rate = (2000 ÷ 20000) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹20,000

**Time (T)** = 2 years

**Simple Interest (SI)** = ₹4,000

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f37823af79867687a9cb6fe253f72c2975e35f8e2bff0c2764ddcabe972d1096.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4000 = (20000 × R × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 4000 = 200 × R × 2

⇒ 4000 = 400 × R

⇒ R = 4000 ÷ 400

⇒ R = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is the interest calculated only on the principal amount for the entire duration. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) / 100.

Total Amount (A)

The sum of the principal and the interest earned over a period. A = P + SI.

Rate of Interest (R)

The percentage of the principal charged as interest per unit time. R = (SI × 100) / (P × T).
